title: Weather and Day Length
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Weather and Day Length Worksheets (Weather Charts)
standard_text: Observe and describe weather associated with the seasons and how day length varies.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on weather and day length: weather symbols and words, a weather chart, what to do in different weather and how long the days are. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Summer days are long; winter days are short.
body_html:
How to think about it

The weather changes with the seasons.

  • Summer days are long and warm.
  • Winter days are short and cold.
  • We can record the weather on a chart.
Example

Which season has the longest days?

Light until late

Answer: summer

Example

White flakes fall from the sky. Weather?

Cold

Answer: snowy

Common mistakes

  • Thinking days are the same length all year.
  • Thinking snow is most likely in summer.
  • Thinking a cloud symbol always means rain.

faq.q: What weather do we get in each season?
faq.a: Spring has showers and warmer days, summer is warmest and sunniest, autumn is windy and wet, and winter is coldest, with frost and sometimes snow.

faq.q: Why are the days longer in summer?
faq.a: In summer the Sun rises early and sets late, so there are more hours of daylight. In winter it rises late and sets early.

faq.q: How can we record the weather?
faq.a: Keep a weather chart: each day, write or draw the weather. A thermometer and a rain gauge help us measure it.
